newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS details profit from Motor-Columbus.
newsitem.headline: UBS details profit from Motor-Columbus.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland will see a net profit of about 100 million Swiss francs from its sale of a 40 percent stake in utility holding Motor-Columbus AG, a UBS spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman confirmed a Swiss newspaper interview with UBS Executive Vice-President Urs Rinderknecht, who sits on the board of Motor-Columbus as the bank's representative.
"It will be about 100 million Swiss francs at the group level," Rinderknecht told the daily Tages-Anzeiger when asked how much the sale would bring in net profit.

UBS said on Sunday it would sell two Motor-Columbus stakes of 20 percent each to French utility Electricite de France International SA (EDF) and Germany's RWE (Rheinisch-Westfaelische Elektrizitaetswerk AG) for a total of 526 million Swiss francs.
Motor-Columbus's main asset is a 56 percent holding in Swiss power utility Atel.
UBS said it would keep its remaining 35.6 percent stake in Motor-Columbus "for the time being", retaining its status as the single largest shareholder.
